Poly encoders outperform Bi encoders on all tasks, that Poly encoders trained on large datasets are faster and more accurate than Cross encoders, that the best results on the four tasks are obtained by pretraining on large datasets similar in size to the downstream tasks and that the best pre training strategies for Poly encoders are to train on large datasets that are similar in size to downstream tasks.

Poly encoders, pre trained on large datasets, are fast, accurate, and state of the art for multi sentence scoring.
